forum.title: Issue regarding the failure of memory-mapped functionality on STM32N657X0H3Q
forum.best_answer_content: it’s has been solved. the reason of this problem is the speed of XSPI is to high for my PCB’s designation. When i made a test that it not include memory-mapped mode, in fact, the speed of XSPI is 50MHz,not 200MHz。
forum.author: jungle_bert
